_comment: Project-level Claude Code hooks (template). 主线分支与 PROGRESS 路径通过 git/gh CLI 自动检测；如自动检测失败，把 [MAIN_BRANCH] 与 [PROGRESS_PATH] 改成项目实际值。

PreToolUse._comment: H1 — 拦危险 Bash cmd: 1) git hook bypass; 2) force-push main; 3) rm -rf 保护目录; 4) chained pipe with git checkout/merge

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*(echo|printf|cat[[:space:]]+<<)'; then echo '{}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit[[:space:]]+(commit|push|merge|rebase|stash|tag|cherry-pick|am|revert)\b.*(--no-verify|--no-gpg-sign|-c[[:space:]]+commit\.gpgsign=false)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: git hook bypass forbidden. Investigate root cause."}'; exit 0; fi; MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+push.*-f.*\\b(main|$MAIN_BRANCH)\\b"; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: force-push to main branch forbidden."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]*(\.claude|docs|migrations)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: rm -rf protected dirs (.claude/docs/migrations)."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(checkout|merge|rebase|reset)\b.*\|[[:space:]]*(tail|head|awk)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: chained pipe with git checkout/merge eats fatal exit code. Use independent Bash calls."}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

PostToolUse._comment: H2 — sprint merge 后提醒 PROGRESS sync

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+merge[[:space:]]+--no-ff[[:space:]]+$MAIN_BRANCH\\."; then echo '{"systemMessage":"sprint merge detected. Next: update PROGRESS.md (per .claude/rules/progress-conventions.md)."}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

SessionStart._comment: H6 — 会话起 work state 摘要 + PROGRESS 行数检查

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" 2>/dev/null; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); LAST3=$(git log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null | head -3 | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|$//'); MAIN_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|refs/remotes/origin/||' || echo main); AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count origin/$MAIN_BRANCH..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); PROGRESS_PATH="[PROGRESS_PATH]"; if [ "$PROGRESS_PATH" = "[PROGRESS_PATH]" ] || [ ! -f "$PROGRESS_PATH" ]; then PROGRESS_PATH=$(find . -maxdepth 3 -iname 'progress.md' 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; LINES=$(wc -l < "$PROGRESS_PATH" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); OPEN=$(gh issue list --state open 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0); WARN=""; if [ "$LINES" -gt 250 ]; then WARN=" | ⚠️ PROGRESS $LINES lines > 250 — 触发归档"; fi; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Branch: $BRANCH | ahead $AHEAD | open issues: $OPEN | PROGRESS: $LINES lines$WARN | last: $LAST3\"}"; exit 0
